_doc: Lê Hoa Am lineage (rules-proposals R5). Re-leaned Ice, Water -> Ice, Metal with the seat's move up onto Lăng Tuyệt Phong (184). Outer gate (the grey sisters): gate-sword-primer (Metal). Inner gate and above (the white nuns): winter-toll-canon (Ice, existing; the hermitage's bell rite). Secret arts: pear-blossom-snow-sword (inner), sealed-cold-sutra (abbess and the seal-keeper). Proposals are unpriced.

lineage.tree_route_note: Frost Seed (Sương Chủng) and Crossguard (Kiếm Cách): the hermitage's two halves, the toll's first Ice stack and the gate sword's raised guard.

techniques.name: Gate Sword Primer (Sơn Môn Kiếm Quyết)
techniques.concept: The grey sisters' method, taught at the Gate Hermitage. It draws the mountain's Metal qi into a short, upright sword that is drilled for one purpose: to stand in a doorway and not be moved. Its forms all face one way, downhill. It never cultivates Ice, and the grey sisters know it: it is a guard's method, and they are the hermitage's guard.

arts.concept: A guarding stance: while the holder stays Composed with sword raised, the next hit on her is halved and the striker takes a light Metal hit back.

techniques.lore: Written by the founder Kỷ Hoa Ảnh in 702, the year she sealed the cave above the hermitage, so that the women at the gate could hold it without her.

techniques.name: Pear Blossom Snow Sword (Lê Hoa Tuyết Kiếm)
techniques.concept: The white nuns' sword, made from the night in 600 when snow fell like pear blossom in the eighth month (A103). The blade throws off a drift of frost petals that hang in the air. A foe moving through them gathers Ice stacks, and a nun standing in them moves more lightly. It is slow to learn and gentle to watch, and those who have fought it say it is like being buried.

arts.concept: Scatters a field of frost petals for a few seconds; each second the foe presses while it is up, it gains an Ice stack.

arts.new: One Branch of Pear (Nhất Chi Lê)
arts.concept: A single thrust that deals Metal damage and, against a foe with five or more Ice stacks, pierces their ward.

techniques.lore: Only white nuns learn it. A grey sister who awakens Ice is taught it on the night she takes the white robe. Its first forms are the first six layers of Hoắc Hàn Quang's North Wind, Cold Light Sword, which the founder learned from him (hermits-sages; settled in the cross-sect pass).

techniques.name: Sealed Cold Sutra (Phong Hàn Kinh)
techniques.concept: The founder's seal method. It teaches how to close a place with cold so that nothing, qi, sound or a sword's light, passes out of it, and how to renew the seal by sitting against it for a season. It is the art that has kept Hoắc Hàn Quang's cave shut since 700 (C014). In a fight it lays cold seals on a foe's arts: each seal slows one art, and the fourth stills them all for a breath.

arts.concept: Seals one of the foe's arts with cold: its cooldown is lengthened and its damage lowered; the fourth seal stills all their arts for a breath.
A stance: while the holder sits, her ward regenerates and seals she has laid last longer.

techniques.lore: Taught only to the abbess and the one nun who walks with her to the seal every fifty years. Thái Lê Tuyết has not chosen the next one.
